re mlatu cu pinxe lo ladru

ci mlatu cu citka re -meat-

To practice numbers:

parecivomu

xazebisono

, being <12345'67890> but eventually

lipa lire lici

lici livo limu

lixa lize libi

libi liso lino

, and then

lipa lire lici livo limu

lixa lize libi liso linu,

meaning:

"1,2,3;3,4,5;6,7,8;8,9,0"

and

"1,2,3,4,5;6,7,8,9,0"

respectively.


New Words:

no - 0 

pa - 1 

re - 2 

ci - 3 

vo - 4 

mu - 5 

xa - 6 

ze - 7 

bi - 8 

so - 9

li - number nounifier
